question: what tip load may be assumed from shaft force and shaft bending moment
theorem: y = L + S and M = l*L + r*S give L = (M - r*y)/(l - r), re-derived symbolically by this coordinator; singular at l = r, the axially collinear case
why_force_alone_fails: the shaft identifies only the sum A(T,h) + b*v + S; 53248 indistinguishable pair cases at exact observation error zero, and one sharp example admits 0.2 to 0.8 N of tip load at identical shaft force, a factor of 4
what_temperature_buys: adhesion changes, not the absolute offset
what_fails_alone: speed, phase and depth; adhesive memory reproduces a damping phase exactly

refusal.reason: below it the moment noise amplification 1/(l-r) exceeds tenfold

control: Coulomb y = mu*P + S, same ambiguity; PMID 26700572, doi 10.1016/j.jmbbm.2015.11.024

coulomb_control_coefficient.source: Urrea et al., J Mech Behav Biomed Mater 56:98-105 (2016), PMID 26700572

falsifier: if a shaft-only observable is found that separates adhesion from other resistance without a second mechanical channel, the theorem is wrong and this decision is unnecessary

geometry_swing_at_identical_shaft_readin.note: the two admissible cases below carry the SAME shaft force and the SAME shaft moment and differ only in where the nuisance contact sits
geometry_swing_at_identical_shaft_readin.reading: a swing of this size at one shaft reading is the same order as the 0.2 to 0.8 N ambiguity proof_lane exhibited, so the lever arms are not a detail of the calibration -- they are an input the decision cannot do without

boundary_note: the third case has separation fraction 0.09999999999999999 in floating point and is refused at exactly the stated threshold; the refusal is reported rather than smoothed

rows.control_coulomb: y = mu*P + S carries the same ambiguity unless the normal load or the nuisance is independently known; the quoted coefficient is static and its dispersion is not a rigorous bound (PMID 26700572)
